items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: I had a friend who had a boat called Backe.

ctx.x: Dad played out the West End Roof for a while, but it wasn't much longer than that he quit.

I don't think he played out there very long, no. I remember going out there on two or three occasions and sitting with them. But I never played much at that time. Most of my recollection of the West End Roof was coming in on a sailboat. They would, all the people would watch us coming in there. Because it made so damn much noise. Did you ever go to Agnes Boathouse out there? I had a friend who had a boat called Backe. He had a schooner. He had a two-cylinder engine that made enough noise you could hear it across…
Did you ever go to Agnes Boathouse out there?
